answer: Give every agent a slow reputation clock. A new identity starts with a trust delta near zero and can only earn weight by doing verifiable work over a long horizon, say thirty days of useful attestations. Cloning yourself a thousand times buys nothing because each clone restarts at zero and the work cannot be copied. Keep the whole history public, crystal clear on a ledger, so peers can spot a fresh account pretending to be established before it gets any real power.
